The club is based in [[Reykjavík]], [[Iceland]], and currently plays in the [[Besta deild karla]], the top league of men's football in Iceland. The team plays its home games at [[Hlíðarendi (stadium)|Hlíðarendi]] in Reykjavík. The team's colours are red and white. Valur has spent most of its time in the top-flight of Icelandic football, spending only three seasons outside the top tier. Valur is one of the most successful football clubs in Iceland, with 23 Icelandic championships."}}
